```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(knitr)
input_file <- "descriptive_statistics.csv"
dat <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
factor_cols <- c("model", "vehicle", "judge_role", "rule_given")
dat[factor_cols] <- lapply(dat[factor_cols], factor)
```

The data in `descriptive_statistics.csv` contains one row per
combination of `model`, `vehicle`, `judge_role`, and `rule_given`
(`r nrow(dat)` cells), with pre-aggregated `Decision` and `Probs`
means and variances.

## Overall summary statistics

```{r overall}
numeric_cols <- c("Decision_mean", "Decision_variance",
                  "Probs_mean", "Probs_variance")
overall_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(numeric_cols, function(col) {
  v <- dat[[col]]
  data.frame(
    variable = col,
    n = sum(!is.na(v)),
    mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}))
kable(overall_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = "Summary of cell-level means and variances")
```

## Decision by model

```{r decision-by-model}
dbm <- aggregate(Decision_mean ~ model, data = dat,
  FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x),
                      min = min(x), max = max(x)))
dbm <- do.call(data.frame, dbm)
names(dbm) <- c("model", "mean", "sd", "min", "max")
kable(dbm, digits = 3,
      caption = "Mean Decision by model (across all conditions)")
```

## Crosstabs of mean Decision

### Model x Vehicle

```{r ct-model-vehicle}
kable(tapply(dat$Decision_mean, list(dat$model, dat$vehicle), mean),
      digits = 3, caption = "Mean Decision: model x vehicle")
```

### Judge role x Rule given

```{r ct-role-rule}
kable(tapply(dat$Decision_mean, list(dat$judge_role, dat$rule_given), mean),
      digits = 3, caption = "Mean Decision: judge_role x rule_given")
```

### Model x Rule given

```{r ct-model-rule}
kable(tapply(dat$Decision_mean, list(dat$model, dat$rule_given), mean),
      digits = 3, caption = "Mean Decision: model x rule_given")
```

## Crosstab of mean Probs

### Model x Vehicle

```{r ct-probs-model-vehicle}
kable(tapply(dat$Probs_mean, list(dat$model, dat$vehicle), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      digits = 3, caption = "Mean Probs: model x vehicle")
```
